Anhui Tongguan Copper Foil.why: makes HVLP high-frequency / high-speed copper foil for CCL / PCB makers; this foil passed 50% of its PCB foil output, so its stock benefits directly from high-speed CCL / substrate build-out
Anhui Tongguan Copper Foil.evidence: Anhui Tongguan Copper Foil IR activity record: 2026-09-18 (09-18-2026): HVLP1-4 in volume supply and fully certified; PCB copper foil customers are mainly CCL and PCB makers; high-frequency / high-speed foil above 50% of PCB foil output

players.product: HVLP high-frequency / high-speed electrodeposited copper foil (HVLP1-4 in volume supply, HVLP5 in development) for copper-clad laminate (CCL) and PCB makers

quarterly_data.quarter: Anhui Tongguan Copper Foil IR activity record: 2026-09-18 (09-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): high-end PCB copper foil is in short supply, with volume and price both rising; in H1 2026 high-frequency / high-speed copper foil exceeded 50% of the company's PCB copper foil output; HVLP copper foil orders on hand are ample and high-value-added orders such as high-frequency / high-speed foil exceed supply; high-end foil capacity follows a certification-first principle and barriers are high.
quarterly_data.figure: above 50% of PCB copper foil output (H1 2026)

quarterly_data.quarter: Anhui Tongguan Copper Foil IR activity record: 2026-09-18 (09-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): the HVLP1-4 series is in volume supply and has passed full-series certification; HVLP4 is in mass production but still ramping, with room for process optimisation and yield improvement; HVLP5 copper foil has broken through key performance indicators and is progressing according to plan.

quarterly_data.quarter: Anhui Tongguan Copper Foil IR activity record: 2026-09-18 (09-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): H1 2026 PCB copper foil revenue was RMB 25.07 hundred million and lithium-battery copper foil revenue RMB 13.74 hundred million; the copper foil industry kept recovering, the lithium-battery foil segment rebounded and high-end PCB copper foil was in short supply.
quarterly_data.figure: RMB 25.07 hundred million PCB copper foil; RMB 13.74 hundred million lithium-battery copper foil (H1 2026)

quarterly_data.quarter: Anhui Tongguan Copper Foil IR activity record: 2026-09-18 (09-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): overseas revenue was 2% of main business revenue in H1 2026; its self-developed high-end HVLP foil has achieved scaled exports. Management: Japanese makers hold a high share of effective global HVLP supply thanks to long process experience and mature supply chains, so the company's domestic substitution is gradual, not a one-time replacement.

quarterly_data.quarter: Anhui Tongguan Copper Foil IR activity record: 2026-09-18 (09-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): PCB copper foil customers are mainly CCL makers and PCB makers; the company broke through technical bottlenecks such as the trade-off between very low profile and high peel strength. Management: high-frequency / high-speed foil is hard to make because of precise equipment with long lead times, complex processes and long, demanding customer certification.

quarterly_data.quarter: Anhui Tongguan Copper Foil IR activity record: 2026-09-18 (09-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): the company has built multiple HVLP copper foil lines and in 2025 bought several additional surface-treatment machines to expand HVLP capacity; it gives no hard full-year HVLP output forecast (output depends on line yield and order scheduling); future capex will centre on product-mix optimisation with scale and pace prudently controlled; any further expansion plan will be disclosed as required.

quarterly_data.quarter: Anhui Tongguan Copper Foil IR activity record: 2026-09-18 (09-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): copper foil is priced as copper price plus processing fee and profit comes mainly from processing fees; product prices will be adjusted to market conditions and the company will raise processing fees at appropriate times; production is make-to-order.

quarterly_data.quarter: Anhui Tongguan Copper Foil IR activity record: 2026-09-18 (09-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): carrier copper foil (for IC package substrates) is in new-product R&D and industrialisation; in lithium-battery foil the shipment share of ultra-thin foil is rising steadily and energy-storage orders keep growing.
